1-cover.note: Flat out along the boulevard in a stolen sedan: city skyline, palms, traffic, HUD, wanted-free minimap and mission one on the objective line.

2-talk.note: On foot at Taller Solano, mid-conversation with Rico: dialogue box, pedestrians, traffic, HUD and minimap.

3-chase.note: Four stars downtown: Interceptors closing in, the police helicopter and its searchlight overhead, minimap full of blue.

4-escape.note: The finale at Muelle 9: three stars on the dock, containers and warehouse, the pier escape objective on the HUD.
